create_pvt_v2_config: create a PvtV2Config instance with custom encoder block depths, attention heads, and patch sizes
build_pvt_v2_model_from_config: build a PvtV2Model using a PvtV2Config initialized with the OpenGVLab/pvt_v2_b0 checkpoint
configure_pvt_v2_linear_attention: configure PvtV2Config to use linear attention with average pooling instead of strided convolution
set_pvt_v2_output_features: set PvtV2Config output features and output indices via set_output_features_output_indices method
initialize_pvt_v2_config_defaults: initialize PvtV2Config with default values for sr_ratios, hidden_sizes, strides, and mlp_ratios
